camel_example: aliyun agenthitldata ProcessApproval --region cn-hangzhou --ApprovalReqId 'APR-cn-hangzhou-00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' --Decision Approve --version 2026-08-10 --method POST --force
description_en: Approves, rejects, or recalls a pending approval request and returns the updated status. You can call GetApprovalDetail to view the operation plan, current status, and specified approvers
description_zh: 同意、拒绝或撤回待处理的审批单，并返回处理后的状态。可通过 GetApprovalDetail 查看操作计划、当前状态和指定审批人
name: ProcessApproval

parameters.help_en: The ID of the approval request. The ID can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 审批单 ID，最长 128 个字符
parameters.name: approval_req_id

parameters.help_en:
The action to perform on the approval request. Valid values:
Approve: Approves the request. Only specified approvers can approve the request.
Reject: Rejects the request. Only specified approvers can reject the request.
Recall: Recalls the request. Only the initiator can recall the request
parameters.help_zh:
处理动作。
Approve 表示同意。只有指定的审批人可以同意。
Reject 表示拒绝。只有指定的审批人可以拒绝。
Recall 表示撤回，只有发起人可以撤回
parameters.name: decision

schema.description_en: The approval status and request ID returned when the request is successfully processed
schema.description_zh: 处理成功时返回的审批状态和请求标识

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is used to trace requests and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的标识，用于关联请求和排查问题

Status.description_en:
The approval status after the action is performed. Valid values:
APPROVED: The request is approved.
REJECTED: The request is rejected.
RECALLED: The request is recalled
Status.description_zh:
执行处理动作后的审批状态。
APPROVED 表示已同意。
REJECTED 表示已拒绝。
RECALLED 表示已撤回
